messages:
sara_ae: Quick heads-up — ACME POC blocked. After switching to Private (VPC) + Dedicated pool they hit a login redirect loop and SCIM user sync is half-failed. Customer says Hosted API keys also fail because they locked down egress IPs. Can infra/SSO help? We need this done today or they pull the pilot.

jamal_se: Which errors do you have? screenshots/logs? Is this on the redwood-private tenant or their on‑prem SCIM endpoint?

sara_ae: They're on our Private deployment (customer-managed network). SCIM points at https://scim.acme-corp.com/v2/Users (customer endpoint). They see a bunch of 504s and some 409s. Login redirects to ACME IdP, then back to our callback, then straight back to IdP (loop).

mia_idp: Looking at the SAML trace from ACME: assertion Audience is https://private.redwood-hosting.com/tenant/acme. Our callback expects https://acme.redwood.internal/ (hostname mismatch). IdP can change Audience quickly but they want us to confirm the SP metadata exactly.

sam_engineer: Cookie/domain thing is probable — session cookie currently set for hostname redwood-hosting.com. For private tenants we need cookieDomain=.acme-corp.com otherwise browser won't send cookie after redirect. Can we change cookieDomain for this tenant?

jamal_se: Also seeing gateway errors from our side when proxying to their SCIM. From logs: ```json
{
  "status": 504,
  "detail": "Gateway timeout contacting SCIM endpoint https://scim.acme-corp.com/v2/Users"
}
```

sam_engineer: For the 409s: ```json
{
  "status": 409,
  "detail": "User already exists with different externalId: email conflict",
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error"]
}
```

lena_sales_engineer: Customer asked if we can bypass SCIM and create a seed group so their admins can sign in while we debug. They also need a temporary API key for the Dedicated pool to smoke test generation endpoints (they can't use Hosted keys due to IP allowlist).

jamal_se: We can issue a short-lived dedicated API key from the console, but for Private deployment the key must be created in their control-plane namespace. I can generate a 24h key if security signs off. @ops_bot please record a temporary key issuance for audit.

ops_bot: Audit log: temporary_key_issue requested by jamal_se for tenant acme-corp. Placeholder ticket #INC-4821.

mia_idp: For SAML: ACME will edit the Audience and ACS to match exactly what we provide. I'll paste the SP metadata snippet they asked for: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://acme.redwood.internal/">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Location="https://acme.redwood.internal/saml/consume" Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST"/>
    <NameIDFormat>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress</NameIDFormat>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

sara_ae: Customer also says the redirect loop only happens in Chrome with SameSite=strict set on cookies. Might be related to the cookieDomain fix.

sam_engineer: Action plan: 1) jamal_se to request temporary API key (24h) — blocked on security approval (ETA 1h). 2) mia_idp to confirm SP metadata and share exact Audience/ACS with ACME (ETA 30m). 3) Change tenant cookieDomain to ".acme-corp.com" in private console and redeploy session config (ETA 45m). 4) If SCIM 504s persist, we'll ask ACME to whitelist our egress IPs or provide reachable SCIM endpoint internally — also open a fallback to do manual seed provisioning.

lena_sales_engineer: I'll tell the customer the workaround (manual seed + temp key) and ask for confirmation to proceed.

jamal_se: I've started the security approval for temp key, ping me if you need escalation.

sara_ae: Thanks. Please keep me posted in this thread. Customer is pretty nervous; if we can get them in within the day it locks the deal. :pray:

sam_engineer: Noted — I'll make the cookieDomain change and post when done. If anyone sees continued 504s after that, drop the raw proxied curl output here.

ops_bot: Provisioning job requeued for tenant acme-corp: ses-config-update (job id job-9f3a).
